caseStyle.task: Choose the thesis direction that best matches the signal bundle.
caseStyle.confidencePrompt: Report confidence as the probability that the selected direction matches the hidden world rule.

earnings_revision.label: earnings revision
earnings_revision.text: Street estimates were revised upward after the latest operating update.

margin_repair.label: margin repair
margin_repair.text: Gross margin pressure is easing as mix and procurement normalize.

cash_flow_quality.label: cash flow quality
cash_flow_quality.text: Free cash flow conversion is improving without a working-capital pull-forward.

valuation_discount.label: valuation discount
valuation_discount.text: The stock trades at a discount to peers after adjusting for growth and leverage.

upside_catalyst.label: upside catalyst
upside_catalyst.text: A near-term catalyst can re-rate the thesis if execution remains intact.

short_crowding.label: short crowding
short_crowding.text: Short interest is crowded enough to amplify a positive revision.

guidance_cut.label: guidance cut
guidance_cut.text: Management cut forward guidance and narrowed the delivery range.

liquidity_risk.label: liquidity risk
liquidity_risk.text: Liquidity runway tightened and refinancing optionality is lower.

event_risk.label: event risk
event_risk.text: A binary event can dominate the near-term return distribution.

drawdown_pressure.label: drawdown pressure
drawdown_pressure.text: Price action is breaking support while realized volatility is rising.

regulatory_risk.label: regulatory risk
regulatory_risk.text: A regulator opened a review that could delay monetization.

risk_budget_tight.label: risk budget tight
risk_budget_tight.text: Portfolio risk budget is tight and incremental exposure must clear a higher bar.

increase_long.label: increase long
increase_long.text: Increase long exposure because thesis quality and upside skew dominate.

maintain_long.label: maintain long
maintain_long.text: Maintain the long thesis while waiting for confirmation.

reduce_exposure.label: reduce exposure
reduce_exposure.text: Reduce exposure because the risk signals now dominate expected upside.

avoid_trade.label: avoid trade
avoid_trade.text: Avoid a new trade because signal conflict is too high.

short_bias.label: short bias
short_bias.text: Adopt a short bias because negative revisions and risk signals dominate.

rationaleTemplates: The rule rewards quality plus revision strength when risk remains contained.
The rule penalizes fragile balance-sheet or event-risk combinations.
The rule treats valuation as useful only when paired with evidence of execution.
The rule treats crowded positioning as an amplifier, not a standalone thesis.
The rule favors capital preservation when portfolio constraints are active.
